subject: Intro & scheduling: Lighthouse demo + IT security participation
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Alice Moore <alice@lighthouse.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo request from Lighthouse — availability & IT invite

Hi Alice — thanks for signing up and for the note. I’m Camila from Redwood’s SDR team, and I’ll get you on the calendar.

Quick summary: you mentioned a 30–45 minute product walkthrough to evaluate inference performance and security posture. Karthik (AE) and Soojin (SE) are cc’d — can you confirm whether IT/security should join for the demo (we usually have a 10–15 minute segment for network/KMS questions)?

Proposed time windows (converted to BST for your convenience):
- Thu Sep 16, 10:00–10:45 BST / Wed Sep 16 02:00–02:45 PT
- Thu Sep 16, 14:00–14:45 BST / Wed Sep 16 06:00–06:45 PT
- Fri Sep 17, 09:00–09:45 BST / Thu Sep 16 01:00–01:45 PT

Please pick one, or suggest a couple of alternatives. If IT will join, please cc them or share their contact — we’ll send a short checklist (network endpoints, allowed egress, KMS flow) ahead of time.

Calendar link to confirm: https://cal.example.com/camila/redwood-demo-30m

Attachments: demo-one-pager.pdf (internal reference)

Thanks — Camila
Camila Reyes
SDR | Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

From: Alice Moore <alice@lighthouse.io>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Bob Jennings <it-support@lighthouse.io>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 16:42:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Demo request from Lighthouse — availability & IT invite

Hi Camila — thanks for the prompt. Sorry for the scatter — we’re in London (BST) so the times you sent work. Prefer Thu Sep 16 at 14:00 BST.

I’ve cc’d Bob from our infrastructure team; he’ll need the checklist to confirm firewall/VPN allowances. We typically require a short security blurb and an outbound IP (or FQDN) for the demo so we can whitelist it.

Also, can you confirm whether there will be any screen recordings or live data forwarded during the demo? Our compliance folks ask that we flag recordings up front.

Best,
Alice Moore
Product Manager | Lighthouse Networks
alice@lighthouse.io

Attachment: (none yet)

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Moore <alice@lighthouse.io>, Bob Jennings <it-support@lighthouse.io>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 08:55:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Demo request from Lighthouse — availability & IT invite

Fwding Alice’s confirmation — she picked Thu Sep 16 at 14:00 BST (that’s 06:00 PT for us).

Karthik / Soojin — can you confirm availability for that slot? Also:
- Bob (IT) asked for outbound IP/FQDN and a short note on whether the session will be recorded.
- If we’re doing a live connect to their VPC or showing actual tenant data, flag it here; otherwise we’ll use a sanitized demo dataset.

I’ve attached the IT checklist we send to customers — please review and add any SE notes that are mandatory. If 14:00 BST doesn’t work, propose a fallback (we should keep at least one option within their working hours).

Attachments: lighthouse_it_checklist.pdf

Thanks,
Camila

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Moore <alice@lighthouse.io>, Bob Jennings <it-support@lighthouse.io>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Demo request from Lighthouse — availability & IT invite

Thanks for the ping — I can do Sep 16 but need to shift 1 hour earlier on my calendar: 13:00 BST instead of 14:00 (that’s 05:00 PT). Soojin, are you able to make 13:00 BST? If not, I can do 14:00 but would prefer 13:00 to avoid a conflict with another customer call.

Regarding the IT ask: we will not record the session unless Lighthouse gives explicit permission. Standard approach: we use a sanitized demo dataset and only show their API contract if they request a connectivity test. For the whitelist, we provide FQDN(s) and egress port ranges in the checklist. Soojin — please add any specific network rules (eg. ranges for KV cache calls or telemetry endpoints) to the checklist.

Doc note for Bob: outbound FQDNs: demo1-prod.redwood-inference.com, telemetry.redwood-inference.com — we’ll also include a short blurb on KMS flow and retention.

I’ll mark my calendar tentatively for 13:00 BST pending Soojin and Alice.

Cheers,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0192

From: Alice Moore <alice@lighthouse.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2026 14:02:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Fwd: Demo request from Lighthouse — availability & IT invite

Hi Karthik (and team) — 13:00 BST is fine with us. Bob has reviewed the checklist and attached a cropped screenshot of our firewall console showing where they’ll add the FQDN.

We confirm: no recording, sanitized demo data only, and Bob will do the whitelist before the session.

See you Thu Sep 16 at 13:00 BST / 05:00 PT. I’ll accept the calendar invite when it comes through.

Thanks — Alice
